clauses.clause: Corpse piles ≤ ~1 m, no stretched limbs; player never drawn under a corpse.
clauses.note: Actual production CorpseLayout.audit reports corpse roots lifted1.76m low and2.86m high above their source feet, already exceeding the ~1m pile limit before adding body thickness. Worst rendered-second samples and full layout audit timeline retained. These are ground heap lifts, not airborne corpseBlast positions (the production layout excludes those flights). This closes FAIL through pile height; no claim that all limbs or continuous player/corpse ordering pass. The two entry frames do not frame the remote piles; the quantitative counterexample is the actual shared render layout.
